evals.prompt: 为一个新增活动报名功能生成 requirement-arrangement workbench 的完整规划 JSON。需求包括活动详情、报名提交、报名状态查询；未明确名额限制和重复报名规则；已知前端仓库 activity-web，后端仓库 registration-service。
evals.expected_output: A schema_version 3.2 planning state with four stages, frontend/backend modules, material review items, executable tasks, reconciled estimates, valid dependencies, and a dependency-respecting schedule.
expectations: Top-level JSON contains schema_version, requirement, evaluation, tasks, revision
Exactly four evaluation stages exist: understanding, breakdown, estimation, scheduling
Understanding modules include side, name, repository, and change_summary
Unknown business rules are represented as review_items instead of fabricated facts
Breakdown task_ids exactly match top-level task IDs
Estimation total equals the sum of task effort_days
Confidence buckets match task confidence values
Dependencies reference existing tasks and contain no cycle
Scheduling dates respect dependencies and critical_path IDs exist

evals.prompt: 基于已有 planning JSON 更新：用户把 BE-01 的 effort_days 从 2 改成 2.5，并把负责人改为后端 C；其他人工修改必须保留。更新所有受影响的下游字段，但不要重新覆盖需求理解和无关任务。
evals.expected_output: The human edits remain authoritative, estimation totals/buckets remain consistent, scheduling is reconsidered if needed, and revision records the update.
expectations: BE-01 assignee remains 后端 C
Only affected downstream outputs are changed
revision.version increases and revision.changes records the update
